name: Cube
description:
Cube is the agentic analytics platform, built on a semantic layer. This connector brings it to where you already work.

The semantic layer is what makes the AI useful. Your data team defines metrics, dimensions and joins once, and Claude answers against those definitions rather than raw tables — "revenue" means what your team decided it means, not what a column name implies. Claude can search the model, run read-only SQL through the Cube SQL API, and page through large results.

It can also build and publish dashboards, edit existing reports, and — for users with data-model permissions — read and edit the semantic model's source files on a dev branch that never touches production.

Access follows your existing Cube permissions: users only see the deployments, views and model files their role grants them, and row-level security applies to every query.

Requires a Cube account on a Premium or Enterprise plan, with the Viewer role or higher.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Cube to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Cube to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://cubecloud.dev/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Cube MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cube lists 23 MCP tools, including buildPreAggregation, chat, createReport, createWorkbook, deleteDataModelFile, deleteReport, getBranchDiff, getDataModelChanges, getDeploymentEnv, getPreAggregationStatus, listDataModelFiles, and listDeployments.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Cube?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Cube in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Cube requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Cube is developed by Cube Dev. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
